steps.description: Establish baseline: run fail-go corpus + dogfood app gate, capture current frontier errors
Survey every construct in go-sh.go that the go frontend cannot yet lower (continue-past-error probe)
Fix go frontend so it lowers its own source to a complete, valid A1 shIR (package-call returns like shiremit.Emit/golib.Shir, and any other gaps)
Pipe the dogfood A1 through debashc --shir-in-estree and verify it renders to runnable JS
Verify the JS frontend produces identical output to go run on the testdata corpus + on its own source
Commit progress with a clear status note
